rules.description: Verify all 108 active StatVars meet the rolling annual publication lag (GUS BDL publishes year Y-1 in May of year Y).

params.query: SELECT COALESCE(StatVar, 'MISSING') AS StatVar, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats UNION ALL SELECT 'EMPTY_STATS_GUARD', NULL, 0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stats)
params.condition: COALESCE(TRY_CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER), 0) >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months') - 1 AND total_svs = 108

rules.description: Verify all 108 StatVars retain full historical coverage starting at 2003.

params.query: SELECT COALESCE(StatVar, 'MISSING') AS StatVar, MinDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats UNION ALL SELECT 'EMPTY_STATS_GUARD', NULL, 0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stats)

rules.description: Ensure all StatVars share a uniform MaxDate across the dataset.
Ensure every StatVar covers Poland plus all 16 AdministrativeArea1 voivodeships (17 places).
Ensure every StatVar has at least 391 observations (17 places x 23 years).
